cohort: Live singleton births (n=14,326) in France in 2010
finding: Most population-level risk factors were common to both preterm and early-term birth with the exception of primiparity, and BMI which differed by mode of onset of delivery.
mod_finding: BMI was a risk factor for early-term birth in indicated deliveries only, and obesity was a risk factor for early-term birth in indicated deliveries only.
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks gestation) and early-term birth (37 and 38 weeks gestation)
